crossRefs.note: When David had come to the top, where God was worshiped, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his tunic…
When Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, had come to Absalom, Hushai said to Absalom, “Long live the king! Long live…

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Archites
people.line: Inhabitants of a region near Bethel

people.name: Hushai
people.line: David's friend and advisor who helped him during Absalom's rebellion.

translations.web: Then Absalom said, “Now call Hushai the Archite also, and let’s hear likewise what he says.”
translations.bsb: Then Absalom said, “Summon Hushai the Archite as well, and let us hear what he too has to say.”
translations.kjv: Then said Absalom, Call now Hushai the Archite also, and let us hear likewise what he saith.
translations.asv: Then said Absalom, Call now Hushai the Archite also, and let us hear likewise what he saith.
